data.one_liner: A SliverList that implicitly animates changes using diffutil.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SliverList widget that automatically calculates and implicitly animates changes when items are inserted, removed, or updated. It supports both a list of keyed widgets and data objects.
use_when: You need an animated SliverList that reacts to list modifications automatically
You want to animate list items fading, sizing, or shifting using diff calculations
avoid_when: You are using a standard ListView instead of a Sliver-based list
You mutate the underlying list directly without creating a new copy for state updates
strengths: Supports custom insert and remove animations
Can build from a list of data items or a list of keyed widgets
weaknesses: Requires careful handling of list mutability to allow proper diffing
Items from data lists must implement equality comparison correctly
data.minimal_example:
DiffUtilSliverList<int>(
  items: list,
  builder: (context, item) => Container(
    color: colors[item % colors.length],
    height: 48,
    width: double.infinity,
  ),
  insertAnimationBuilder: (context, animation, child) => FadeTransition(
    opacity: animation,
    child: child,
  ),
  removeAnimationBuilder: (context, animation, child) => SizeTransition(
    sizeFactor: animation,
    child: child,
  ),
)
